jobs.occupation: People Analytics & Rewards Specialist
jobs.employer_name: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
As Impact Fund Denmark continues to grow and professionalise, we want more of our people and organisational decisions to be grounded in evidence, data and a clear understanding of what drives behaviour and performance.

That is why we are creating a new role at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent.

You might already work in HR and be looking to build deeper analytical expertise. Or you may come from organisational psychology, economics, analytics or a related field and want to apply your skills in a People & Culture setting.

Either way, what matters most is that you are curious about how organisations work, comfortable working with data, and able to turn analysis into useful insights and practical recommendations and that you take pride in contributing and getting things to impact.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Your role is to help us understand our organisation better — and use that understanding to make better decisions.

Your work will span analytics, reward and talent. You will:

• 
Analyse employee, performance, engagement, talent and compensation data

• 
Turn data and research into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for People & Culture and management

• 
Support compensation benchmarking and our annual salary and compensation processes

• 
Contribute to the implementation of the EU Pay Transparency requirements, including the related analysis and reporting

• 
Develop dashboards, recurring People reporting and metrics that help us focus on what matters

• 
Analyse engagement survey results and help turn them into meaningful organisational actions

• 
Support talent, succession and performance processes with analysis and insight

• 
Bring relevant research from organisational psychology and behavioural science into the way we design and evaluate People initiatives

• 
Challenge assumptions and help us understand whether our interventions are having the intended effect

• 
Prepare clear presentations and decision material for colleagues and leadership

• 
Contribute to selected organisational development and talent projects

YOUR FIRST YEAR

By the end of your first year, we would expect to see progress in five areas:

• 
Data: our People reporting and analytics are clearer, more consistent and more useful

• 
Reward: compensation processes are supported by reliable analysis and relevant market data

• 
Listening: employee survey data is translated into meaningful insights rather than simply reported

• 
Evidence: important People initiatives increasingly have a clear evidence base, purpose and intended outcome

• 
Decision support: People & Culture and leadership receive concise, relevant analysis that helps them make better decisions

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This is what we need to see:

• 
A relevant academic background, for example in psychology, organisational psychology, economics, business, HR, statistics or another analytical discipline

• 
Strong quantitative and analytical skills

• 
A few years of relevant professional experience. We care more about the quality and relevance of your experience than an exact number of years

• 
Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data

• 
The ability to move from data or research to a clear conclusion and a practical recommendation

• 
Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding why People practices work — rather than simply following established practice

• 
Strong written and verbal communication skills

• 
Professional fluency in English

These would be advantages, but they are not requirements:

• 
Previous HR experience

• 
Experience with Compensation & Benefits or Reward

• 
Experience with People Analytics, employee surveys or HR reporting

• 
Knowledge of statistics or research methodology

• 
Experience with Power BI or similar visualisation tools

• 
Experience applying organisational psychology or behavioural science in an organisational setting

• 
Emotional intelligence, active listening and the ability to stay neutral under pressure

• 
Courage to address uncomfortable issues, strong mediation and conflict-resolution capability

• 
Professional fluency in Danish

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

This is an individual-contributor role within People & Culture.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with colleagues responsible for People Partnering, Operations and Recruitment.

Your role is to bring analytical depth and an evidence-based perspective to the areas where it can improve our decisions — particularly Reward, Talent, engagement and organisational development.

The scope is intentionally broad enough for you to grow and develop, but the professional core is clear: using data and evidence to improve people and organisational decisions.

WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to:

• 
Help build a new capability at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent

• 
Work closely with the Head of People & Culture and colleagues across the function

• 
Apply data, research and behavioural science to real organisational questions

• 
Build broad experience across compensation, talent, engagement and organisational development

• 
Work in an organisation where the People agenda connects to a wider purpose: our colleagues support investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries

PRACTICAL DETAILS

• 
Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

• 
Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

• 
Hybrid: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home. We aim for first 6 months of employment to be in office for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

• 
Application deadline: 23 September 2026

Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

jobs.occupation: Technical Sales Support Engineer to EYKON, Denmark or Mälardalen, Sweden
jobs.description:
EYKON operates as an independent utility infrastructure technology company built on more than 130 years of utility expertise. Headquartered in Switzerland, with a network of expert local teams, the company serves customers in more than 75 markets and supports over 100 million connected endpoints across the region.

Combining proven metering technology, deep utility expertise and real-world operational insight from one of the largest installed bases in EMEA, EYKON connects what utilities measure with how they operate. This helps customers gain greater visibility, make better decisions, maintain greater control and unlock more value from the infrastructure they already operate.

Do you want to play a key role in the green energy transition while working in the intersection of technology, customer support and commercial development?

EYKON is looking for a Technical Sales Support Engineer to support customers and sales activities across Scandinavia. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating stakeholders and solving a wide variety of customer and business challenges in an international environment.

In this role, you will become a central part of the Scandinavian organisation. Acting as the link between customers, sales teams, product management and technical specialists, you will help ensure that customers receive the right support while contributing to the continued growth of the business across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

The Role

As Technical Sales Support Engineer, you will support Scandinavian customers and the Nordic Sales organisation across EYKON's portfolio of hardware, software and service solutions. The role combines customer support, pre-sales, order management and stakeholder coordination in a truly international environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Supporting customers across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
    Coordinating customer-related activities and acting as the customer's internal ambassador.
    Working in close cooperations with order management team
     Following up on logistics, deliveries and customer commitments.
    Providing technical and commercial support to the sales organisation
    Supporting tenders, RFQs and commercial projects.
    Participating in pre-sales initiatives and customer-facing activities.
    Conducting customer, market and competitor analysis.
    Coordinating activities between customers and internal specialists.
    Supporting customer training, product documentation and knowledge transfer together with Training team och Product Management.

This is a highly collaborative role where your ability to build relationships and navigate different stakeholder groups will be just as important as your technical understanding. You will work closely with experienced specialists while gradually developing extensive knowledge of EYKON's products, solutions and customers.

The preferred location is Sorø, Denmark, but strong candidates located in Sweden, particularly in the Örebro/Mälardalen region, will also be considered. Travel within Scandinavia is included in the role.

Is this you?

To be successful in this role, you have experience from a customer-facing B2B environment involving technical sales, customer support, sales support, application support, pre-sales or similar technical-commercial responsibilities. You are comfortable working with technical products, systems or solutions and enjoy building strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders. Experience coordinating activities across multiple functions and stakeholders is important, as is the ability to support quotations, tenders and customer-related projects. You understand how hardware, software and services interact within a broader solution environment and are able to translate technical topics into practical customer value. Professional proficiency in English together with Swedish and/or Danish language skills is required in the role, as the position involves daily collaboration with colleagues and customers across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

Experience from the energy sector, utilities, smart metering, infrastructure, automation or related technical industries is considered an advantage, but we welcome candidates from a broad range of technical and technical-commercial environments. The most important factor is your ability to learn, build relationships and create value for customers.

In this recruitment, your personal qualities will be of great importance. We are looking for a proactive, structured and customer-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and driving activities forward. You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable operating in the intersection between commercial and technical discussions. As a person, you enjoy creating structure, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring that things get done. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by building relationships, solving problems and supporting both customers and colleagues.

Do you want to know more?

If you have further questions don´t hesitate to contact senior recruitment consultant Stina Koskijev at +46735588921, or stina.koskijev@levelrecruitment.se. Please note, no applications are allowed on email. 

Please highlight your key skills and industry experience.

jobs.occupation: Chief Accountant to Schneider Electric- Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Mpya Finance is recruiting a Chief Accountant to Schneider Electric in Copenhagen – a key role for you who want to combine technical accounting expertise with impact, development and an international context.

If you are looking to advance your career, this is your opportunity to take the next step and develop together with Schneider.

At Schneider Electric, sustainability, innovation and performance go hand in hand. This is an opportunity to become a trusted financial partner in an organization that is actively shaping the future of energy.

About the role

As Chief Accountant, you will play a central role in ensuring high-quality financial reporting and compliance across the Nordic and Baltic entities, working closely with the global Shared Service Center in India. You will be part of a strong, international finance organization where collaboration, continuous improvement and professional development are highly valued.

The role offers both responsibility and variety – from statutory reporting and balance sheet ownership to process improvements and cross-border collaboration.

Your main responsibilities:

    

Ensure high quality and accuracy in financial reporting

    

Lead monthly and quarterly closings in accordance with IFRS and local GAAP

    

Full responsibility for balance sheet accuracy and reviews

    

Ownership of annual reports, income tax returns and tax reporting

    

Lead Balance Sheet Review meetings and collaborate with key stakeholders

    

Coordinate and drive external audits for assigned legal entities

    

Drive simplification, standardization and continuous improvement of accounting processes

    

Participate in finance projects, system improvements and ad hoc analyses

Who are we looking for?

To succeed in this role, we believe you have a solid accounting foundation and the confidence to take ownership in a complex, international environment.

We are looking for someone who has:

• A degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent

• At least 3 years of experience working with Danish accounting, preferably in a global organization

• Experience working with a Shared Service Center (meritorious)

• Strong skills in SAP (or similar), Excel and other MS tools

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken

As a person, you are structured, methodical, and quality-driven. You take ownership of your responsibilities, work proactively, and thrive in a complex international environment. At the same time, you are a true team player who enjoys collaborating closely with colleagues and stakeholders across functions and geographies.

We believe that success in this role comes from balancing strong individual accountability with a collaborative mindset. You build trust easily, communicate clearly, and actively contribute to the team's results and development. You enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues, and working together to achieve common goals.

What Schneider Electric offers

At Schneider Electric, you will join a globally recognized company with a strong commitment to sustainability, innovation and people development. You will be part of a professional and forward-looking finance organization where you are encouraged to grow, challenge existing ways of working and develop your career over time.

This is a role where your expertise truly matters – and where you can make a real impact.

Learn more at www.se.com

Application

In this recruitment, Schneider Electric cooperates with Mpya Finance. Selection is ongoing, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For questions about the role or the process, please contact: Kristina Bennet – kristina.bennet@mpya.se Johanna Andersson – johanna.andersson@mpya.se 

Welcome with your application – we look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

-Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
-Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
-General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

-Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
-Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
-Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
-Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
-Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
-Not be afraid of getting dirty
-Understand and speak English
-Be an EU citizen
 
Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
-Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
-Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
-Start date: as soon as possible
-Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
-Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

jobs.occupation: Network & Client Management, Denmark

    Initiate contact with C-level Executives by phone and on LinkedIn to excite them about our concept
    Demonstrate the value of our service and convince them to become part of our exclusive business network in personal scheduled videocall meetings
    Build strong, long-term relationships with C-level executives
    Learn more about their interests, investments plans and upcoming projects
    Develop and execute strategies to expand our network and build valuable relationships, by knowing your customers key challenges and focus areas
    Contribute to the overall growth and success of Management Events

What We’re Looking For

    1–2 years of client-facing experience in a commercial or B2B environment
    Previous experience with cold calling and building business relationships
    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
    Strong business acumen and a results-oriented mindset
    Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment
    Passion for connecting with key industry players and driving business growth
    Proactive and persistent approach to reaching new clients and overcoming challenges
    Fluency in Danish and English

jobs.occupation: Senior Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI's global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
-Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
-Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
-Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI's corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
Flexible working hours - including possibilities for remote work.
Global career prospects - work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
Skills development and career growth - Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance
On-site canteen - light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
Company sports & social activities - from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we're about
But we're more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive - if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies - the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

General Manager — Diamond Slice, København (Nørrebro)

Med to velbesøgte kvarter-lokationer på Nørrebro (Blågårds Plads og Tagensvej 79), en voksende cateringforretning og et markant fodaftryk på Roskilde Festival og sommerevents, søger vi nu en skarp og handlekraftig General Manager.

Som General Manager leder du forretningssiden af Diamond Slice. I tæt parløb med vores Operations Manager og teamledere etablerer du solide systemer, driver FOH-performance og sikrer, at vores lokationer kører gnidningsfrit, effektivt og selvkørende.

Forretningsdrift & systemer:

Drive den daglige forretningsdrift på tværs af lokationer i tæt parløb med vores Operations Manager.

Opbygge, optimere og fastholde pålidelige faste rutiner, systemer og ansvarsfordeling i teamet.

Styre bestillingsrutiner, lager og vareoptælling samt træde til og dække for vores Operations Manager ved behov.

• 
Opdage flaskehalse i tide og eksekvere praktiske løsninger proaktivt.

• 
FOH-ledelse & gæstfrihed:

• 
Lede, sparre med og inspirere FOH-medarbejdere og skifteledere.

• 
Have det fulde ejerskab over FOH-vagtplanlægning og sikre, at lønmålene konsekvent overholdes.

• 
Rekruttere, onboarde og oplære teammedlemmer til Diamond Slices servicestandarder.

• 
Håndtere gæstefeedback, kundehenvendelser og daglig kommunikation.

• 
Catering, festivaler & vækst:

• 
Koordinere indkomne cateringforespørgsler og eventlogistik med Operations Manager og eventteamet.

• 
Tage det operationelle ejerskab over Diamond Slices festivalsetups (herunder Roskilde Festival), inklusiv frivillige, bemanding og logistik.

• 
Drive lokal forretningsudvikling, samarbejder og community-aktiveringer.

• 
Økonomistyring & rapportering:

• 
Følge op på det daglige salg, lønomkostninger og dækningsgrader for at identificere optimeringsmuligheder.

• 
Klargøre ugentlige løn- og performancerapporter forud for ledelsesmøder.

• 
Rapportere drift, bemanding og strategiske forslag løbende til ejerkredsen/bestyrelsen.

Hvem vi søger

• 
Dokumenteret erfaring: 2+ års ledererfaring fra tempofyldt restaurationsdrift (f.eks. som General Manager, Assistant GM eller Operations Manager).

• 
Systemer & tal: Erfaring med vagtplansystemer, POS/lagerstyring og med at holde lønprocenter inden for budgettet.

Hands-on ledelse: Du går forrest under travlhed, bevarer roen under pres og sætter en høj standard for gæstfrihed.

Sprog: Professionelt niveau i engelsk er påkrævet (internationalt team). Dansk på samtale- eller flydende niveau er en klar fordel ift. lokal administration og leverandørdialog.

Hvad vi tilbyder

En definerende lederrolle i et af Københavns mest anerkendte pizzakoncepter.

• 
Reelt mandat og indflydelse på virksomhedens processer, teamkultur og forretningsvækst.

• 
En støttende og sammentømret teamkultur med høj energi og stort fokus på håndværket.

• 
Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer samt personalegoder.

• 
En fleksibel arbejdsplan.

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til work@diamondslice.dk med emnet "General Manager — [Dit Navn]".

ENGLISH VERSION

General Manager — Diamond Slice, Copenhagen (Nørrebro)

Do you thrive in high-energy hospitality, love sourdough pizza made at the highest level, and bring the operational backbone to run a fast-growing restaurant brand?

Since opening on Blågårds Plads, Diamond Slice has redefined New York-style pizza in Copenhagen. With two bustling neighborhood shops in Nørrebro (Blågårds Plads and Tagensvej 79), an expanding catering wing, and a major footprint at Roskilde Festival and summer events, we are looking for a sharp, driven General Manager.

As General Manager, you will lead the business side of Diamond Slice. Working in close partnership with our Operations Manager and team leaders, you will establish solid systems, drive FOH performance, and ensure our shops run smoothly, efficiently, and autonomously.

Key Focus Areas & Responsibilities

• 
Business Operations & Systems:

• 
Drive day-to-day business operations across locations alongside the Operations Manager.

• 
Build, streamline, and maintain dependable daily routines, systems, and team accountability.

• 
Oversee ordering schedules, inventory, and stock control; step in to cover for the Operations Manager when needed.

• 
Spot bottlenecks early and execute practical solutions proactively.

• 
FOH Leadership & Hospitality:

• 
Lead, mentor, and inspire Front of House staff and shift leaders.

• 
Own FOH rota management and ensure labor targets are consistently met.

• 
Recruit, onboard, and train team members to Diamond Slice's service standards.

• 
Handle guest feedback, inquiries, and daily customer communications.

• 
Catering, Festivals & Growth:

• 
Coordinate incoming catering requests and event logistics with the Operations Manager and event team.

• 
Take operational ownership of Diamond Slice’s festival setups (including Roskilde Festival), including volunteers, staff, and logistics.

• 
Drive local business development, collaborations, and community activations.

• 
Financial Control & Reporting:

• 
Monitor daily sales, labor costs, and operational margins to identify efficiency gains.

• 
Prepare weekly labor and performance summaries for leadership meetings.

• 
Report regularly on operations, staffing, and strategic proposals to the ownership group/board.

What We Are Looking For

• 
Proven Track Record: 2+ years of management experience in high-tempo hospitality (e.g., General Manager, Assistant GM, or Operations Manager).

• 
Systems & Numbers: Experience managing scheduling tools, POS/inventory setups, and keeping labor percentages on budget.

• 
Hands-on Leadership: You lead by example during rushes, bring calm energy under pressure, and set high hospitality standards.

• 
Languages: Professional working proficiency in English is required (international team). Conversational or fluent Danish is a strong advantage for local administration and supplier coordination.

What We Offer

• 
A defining leadership role in one of Copenhagen’s most celebrated pizza concepts.

• 
Real autonomy and influence over company processes, team culture, and business growth.

• 
A supportive, close-knit team culture with great energy and high craftsmanship.

• 
Competitive salary matching qualifications, and company perks.

• 
A flexible schedule.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter to work@diamondslice.dk with the subject line "General Manager — [Your Name]".

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
